label: BRAND AND PACKAGING
title: A brand that looks like the price you charge.
intro: Customers judge the price by the logo, the box and the page. We build the brand that makes the product look as good as it is.
whatTitle: A brand people trust before they read a word.

cells.title: A logo that works small
cells.body: A primary logo, a mark and lockups that still read on a label, a pin or a WhatsApp photo.

cells.title: Colour, type and voice
cells.body: A palette, a type pair and how you sound, written down so everyone uses them the same way.

cells.title: Packaging per product
cells.body: Boxes, labels and stickers sized for your printer, with print files ready to send.

cells.title: Guidelines in Figma, owned by you
cells.body: Every file in your name. Your next designer opens it and keeps going, no handover call.

cells.title: Social and print kit
cells.body: Post templates, stories and a business card, so new content looks like the brand on day one.

options: A full brand that feels dated

label: WEBSITES AND STORES
title: A website that proves the work, or a store that sells.
intro: Not every business needs a store. An engineering firm needs proof; a skincare brand needs checkout. We build the one you need, fast on Nigerian mobile data.
whatTitle: A site that loads on 3G and sells while you sleep.

cells.title: Fast on Nigerian data
cells.body: Built in Astro, light images, no bloat. It opens before your customer gives up.

cells.title: Checkout that works here
cells.body: Card, transfer and USSD through Paystack. Delivery fees by area, worked out for you.

cells.title: Domain and hosting in your name
cells.body: You own every account from day one. We are added as helpers and removed when you say.

cells.title: Change prices yourself
cells.body: Edit products, prices and photos from your phone. No ticket, no waiting for us.

cells.title: Found on Google and WhatsApp
cells.body: Search basics done right, and link previews that look good when shared in a chat.

label: AI ASSISTANT
title: An assistant that replies like you, at 2am.
intro: Trained on your products, prices and tone. It answers on your site and WhatsApp in seconds, takes orders and bookings, and hands over to you when it should.
whatTitle: An assistant that sells, and knows when to stop.

cells.title: Trained on your catalogue
cells.body: Products, prices, sizes and delivery areas. Change one and it learns it the same day.

cells.title: Replies like you, at 2am
cells.body: On your website and WhatsApp, in your tone, in seconds. Nobody waits for morning.

cells.title: You decide what it handles
cells.body: It answers and takes orders. Refunds and complaints always come to a person.

cells.title: Orders logged as they happen
cells.body: Every order it takes lands on your phone with the total, the area and the time.

cells.title: A report every month
cells.body: What people asked, what it answered, what it sold. We retrain it on what it missed.

label: AUTOMATION
title: The repetitive work, running on its own.
intro: Order confirmations, receipts, invoices, stock alerts and follow ups. We map what you repeat every day and make it run without you.
whatTitle: The work you repeat daily, running without you.

cells.title: Order to receipt, on its own
cells.body: A payment lands, the receipt goes out and your sales sheet updates. Nobody types it.

cells.title: Stock alerts before you run out
cells.body: A WhatsApp message when a product gets low, with how fast it usually sells.

cells.title: Invoices sent and chased
cells.body: Invoices go out on time and polite reminders follow until they are paid.

cells.title: Follow ups that never forget
cells.body: Thank you, review and reorder messages go out on the right day after every order.

cells.title: A log you can actually read
cells.body: Every run, in plain words. If something fails, we know before you do and fix it.

brief.q: What do you repeat every day?

label: APPS AND MVPS
title: From idea to an app people can touch.
intro: For founders with proof that people want it. Strategy, flows, design and a working first version in weeks, with something new every Friday.
whatTitle: Something new every Friday, until it ships.

cells.title: The flow before the screens
cells.body: We map how people move through it first, so we build the shortest path, not every idea.

cells.title: Designed to be touched
cells.body: Real screens in Figma you can click through on your phone before a line of code.

cells.title: A build you can tap, weekly
cells.body: Every Friday there is a new version on your phone, and a short note on what changed.

cells.title: Built on accounts you own
cells.body: Code, database and hosting sit in your name. Hire anyone later and they pick it up.

cells.title: Launch, then 90 days of care
cells.body: We ship to the stores, watch the crash reports and fix what real users find.

label: MOTION AND FILM
title: Films that explain what you sell.
intro: Launch films and explainers, voice led and paced to read, with your real product on screen. Cut for Instagram, X, LinkedIn and your site.
whatTitle: Films that explain, paced so people read.

cells.title: Script and voice first
cells.body: We write what it says before what it looks like, and you approve every line.

cells.title: Your real product on screen
cells.body: Your actual site, app and packaging, not look-alikes. People see what they will get.

cells.title: Cut for every place it plays
cells.body: Status, Reels, feed, X and your site. Each one framed for that screen, not cropped.

cells.title: Storyboard before animation
cells.body: You approve the frames first, so there are no surprises when the film arrives.

cells.title: Source files, yours to keep
cells.body: Every cut plus the project file, so you can update a price without starting over.
